messages:
maria: Heads-up — working on the legend/controls for the Error Map in Trace Viewer. Need quick design review: ordering, SR labels, and where the export CTA should live. Can we sync briefly?

sam: Left-leaning legend seems intuitive but worried about crowding the timeline. Export CTA should be persistent top-right of the panel not inline with filters.

jeff: Left legend + sticky header might cause reflow for long traces. Can we make it collapsible and lazy-rendered? Also need perf numbers for additional DOM nodes.

nisha: A11y: screen readers must announce the legend as a region. Announce filter changes with aria-live="polite". Also contrast for the legend markers is currently below AA.

maria: Proposal: default collapsed legend (icon only), expands on click/focus. Legend toggle = button with aria-expanded. Bumped marker sizes and use tokenized colors for contrast.

oliver: Copy note: change CTA text from "Export snapshot" -> "Download error snapshot (JSON)" so users know the format.

sam: For smaller viewports we should shorten to "Download JSON". Desktop shows full string.

maria: Good — responsive label. We'll show full label on >= 960px, short label on mobile.

jeff: On backend side, export should include correlation_ids. Recommend endpoint v2/export-traces. I can prototype; include correlation_id in payload.

maria: We should also surface a "Display correlation IDs" toggle in legend; if off, export still includes IDs unless org privacy setting strips them. Need privacy check.

nisha: Keyboard: ensure legend toggle is reachable with two tab stops. For SRs add role="region" aria-label="Error map legend" and tabindex="0" so screen readers can jump. Also provide short SR announcement strings for expand/collapse.

oliver: Colorblindness nit: add pattern/outline options for markers, not just color changes.

maria: I'll update Figma and push a simplified prototype. Can everyone review by EOD? @jeff can you confirm perf impact of collapse/sticky < 5% render time?

jeff: I'll run a local with lazy render + virtualization. If sticky/collapse is heavy we can defer to virtualization.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft copy variants (desktop/mobile) and add microcopy for the correlation toggle.

nisha: :eyes: I'll write the SR announcement strings and test with NVDA/VoiceOver.

maria: Link to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Error-Map-Legend. Notes to prototype: 

````
legendButton: {
  role: 'button',
  'aria-expanded': false,
  tabindex: 0
}
ariaLive: 'polite'
````

I'll upload the updated artboard + interaction spec shortly.

jeff: API note for the export payload: include correlation_ids: ["corr_id_1","corr_id_2"], metadata: ["time_range","trace_id","model_version"]. I'll add the API spec PR after tests.

oliver: Small copy nit: change label from "Show Correlation ID" -> "Display correlation IDs" (verb-first).

maria: Great. I'll push the Figma updates and a short PR with the copy strings and aria attributes. Thanks everyone!
